**archive sweep of the five changes shipped 2026-09-18**

Verified each of issue-998-ui-surface, issue-967-tracker-as-data, issue-1010-candidate-integrity, issue-1020-test-real-root-writes and issue-1029-parent-value-region against the source on main before archiving: every spec requirement traced to code and its test file, all green (relevant suites plus a full 5852/0 run). tasks.md fully ticked for 1010/1020/1029; issue-998 carries one stale unticked box (PR2 T6) whose underlying memory record (rec-6ba8d3282139154c) was actually saved — a bookkeeping slip apply-progress.md wrongly claims was fixed; issue-967 carries seven deliberately-unticked maintainer/forge acts (A9/A10, B5, C9, TR1-3), all documented in apply-progress.md, TR1-3 stale since the tracker (#1004) already opened and merged, C9 (admin brain:protect re-run) genuinely still pending and unrelated to this archive. Archived all five with node brain/scripts/archive.mjs <id>, one commit each; confirmed the #734 defect firsthand — the verb's success message unconditionally claims a spec fusion regardless of whether one happened: only issue-1020 (capability: test-hygiene frontmatter) actually fused into openspec/specs/test-hygiene/spec.md, the other four moved their directory only, verified via git status --short after each run rather than trusting the printed claim. brain:repo:check green; full suite 5852/0, matching the stated baseline exactly.
